findings.text: follow-on: four of the seven changed drivers (first_step_directions, fixed_point_attribution, seed_policy, trip_panels) are imported by no test, so the scanner verifies only that a wall= keyword is present, not that the render path runs; the change to those four is exercised by no runtime check.

follow-on: the report asserts that each of the seven drivers reads committed .npz rather than re-solving, which is the premise of the later regeneration wave, but no check backs the claim and a regeneration node will only confirm or refute it when it runs.

justifications.fit: the change is one keyword per site with no new dependency, abstraction, or banned name, matching the draw_wall(units=units) idiom already at benchmarks/plasma_cell_first_step_directions.py:211.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/plasma_cell_trip_panels.py:517 and the seven sibling sites each pass wall=units, the same collection the panel already hands to draw_wall, so the scattered raster is blanked before contouring.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 68762d363..1cdad46bb shows exactly the seven granted benchmark paths, one conventional commit with a body and no AI trailer, and no plan, shared-index or concurrent-node path.
